title: Multi-Agent Banking ChatBot Model Economics
description: Trace-level quality, performance, workflow cost, token composition, and runtime complexity. Snapshot data; no global time picker.

viz_integrity.title: Data integrity & comparability
viz_integrity.description: All six filter-aware checks are shown together. Differing Dataset versions mean quality is not a strict single-variable model comparison.

viz_kpi.title: Executive · Ground Truth accuracy
viz_kpi.description: Pass percentage uses only scored traces; unscored traces are not treated as failures.

viz_quality.title: Ground Truth adherence by Trace
viz_quality.description: Pass/Fail/Not scored is derived without treating unscored traces as failures.

viz_supervisor_trace.title: Supervisor aggregate output tokens by Trace
viz_supervisor_trace.description: Top-level Supervisor span aggregate; includes downstream Agent output and must not be read as Supervisor-only.

viz_duration_trace.title: Trace duration
viz_duration_trace.description: Root Trace duration in seconds; tooltips retain the underlying precision.

viz_duration_total.title: Executive · Total duration
viz_duration_total.description: Sum of root Trace duration for each model, bounded by Experiment.

viz_cost_trace.title: Application workflow cost by Trace
viz_cost_trace.description: Linear USD scale keeps the highest Trace cost visually prominent; labels retain nine decimal places. Judge cost is excluded.

viz_cost_total.title: Executive · Total workflow cost
viz_cost_total.description: Application workflow cost only, in USD. Independent Judge cost is excluded.

viz_token_composition.title: Supervisor direct vs downstream output tokens
viz_token_composition.description: Composition of root Trace output. Do not add this chart to the aggregate Supervisor metric.

viz_efficiency.title: Efficiency
viz_efficiency.description: Rates are recomputed from Experiment totals, not averaged from row-level rates.

viz_complexity.title: Runtime complexity & errors
viz_complexity.description: Zero errors are neutral; only nonzero errors or LLM timeouts produce a warning.

viz_trace_table.title: Trace detail · click a row to inspect evidence
viz_trace_table.description: The selected trace opens Ground Truth, generated output, Judge rationale, and tool usage below.

options.markdown:
### Selected Trace evidence
Select a row in **Trace detail** to load the source answer, model response, Judge rationale, and tools. Literal `\\n` sequences are converted to readable line breaks only in this display.

viz_trace_detail.title: Selected Trace evidence
viz_trace_detail.description: Display-only newline normalization; the lookup remains unchanged.

options.query:
| inputlookup banking_cn_economics.csv
| stats count by application_model
| rename application_model AS label
| eval value=label
| fields label value
| sort 0 label

| inputlookup banking_cn_economics.csv
| stats count by experiment_name
| rename experiment_name AS label
| eval value=label
| fields label value
| sort 0 label

| inputlookup banking_cn_economics.csv
| stats values(scenario_input) AS question by scenario_key
| eval label=substr(mvindex(question,0),1,72), value=scenario_key
| fields label value
| sort 0 label

| inputlookup banking_cn_economics.csv
| eval comparison_ready=tonumber(comparison_ready)
| search application_model="$tok_model$"
         experiment_name="$tok_experiment$"
         scenario_key="$tok_scenario$"
| eventstats count AS experiment_trace_count by experiment_id
| stats dc(experiment_id) AS experiments
        count AS traces
        sum(comparison_ready) AS ready
        dc(application_model) AS models
        dc(dataset_version) AS dataset_version_count
        values(dataset_version) AS dataset_versions
        min(experiment_trace_count) AS min_traces_per_experiment
        max(experiment_trace_count) AS max_traces_per_experiment
| eval dataset_versions=if(dataset_version_count=0,"No data",mvjoin(dataset_versions,", ")),
       integrity_rows=mvappend(
         "1|||Dataset version alignment|||".dataset_versions."|||".case(traces=0,"WARNING · No data for current filters",dataset_version_count=1,"READY · Dataset versions aligned",1=1,"WARNING · Dataset versions differ; quality is not a strict single-variable model comparison"),
         "2|||Experiments|||".printf("%.2f",experiments)."|||".if(experiments>0,"READY · Experiment boundary is available","WARNING · No Experiment found"),
         "3|||Models|||".printf("%.2f",models)."|||".if(models>0,"READY · Model field is populated","WARNING · No model found"),
         "4|||Traces|||".printf("%.2f",traces)."|||".if(traces>0,"READY · Trace rows loaded","WARNING · No Trace found"),
         "5|||Comparison ready|||".printf("%.2f / %.2f",ready,traces)."|||".if(traces>0 AND ready=traces,"READY · All filtered traces contain core metrics","WARNING · One or more traces are incomplete"),
         "6|||Six-trace coverage|||".if(traces=0,"No data",printf("%.2f–%.2f per Experiment",min_traces_per_experiment,max_traces_per_experiment))."|||".if(min_traces_per_experiment=6 AND max_traces_per_experiment=6,"READY · Every filtered Experiment has 6 traces","WARNING · Filtered Experiment trace counts are not all 6")
       )
| mvexpand integrity_rows
| rex field=integrity_rows "^(?<Order>\d+)\|\|\|(?<Check>[^|]+)\|\|\|(?<Value>[^|]+)\|\|\|(?<Status>.*)$"
| eval Order=tonumber(Order)
| sort 0 Order
| table Check Value Status

| inputlookup banking_cn_economics.csv
| eval ground_truth_adherence_pass=tonumber(ground_truth_adherence_pass),
       ground_truth_adherence_scored=tonumber(ground_truth_adherence_scored),
       comparison_ready=tonumber(comparison_ready),

| eval experiment_short=substr(experiment_id,1,8),

| search application_model="$tok_model$"

| stats sum(ground_truth_adherence_pass) AS passed
        sum(ground_truth_adherence_scored) AS scored
        by experiment_id series_label
| eval accuracy_pct=if(scored>0,round(100*passed/scored,2),null()), metric="Ground Truth"
| chart max(accuracy_pct) over metric by series_label
| rename metric AS Metric
